rows.description: An adult who feels an intense certainty about someone's bad motives pauses to ask whether the same impulse exists in them; naming it takes the heat out and often reveals what they actually need.

rows.subtype: Hitting a sibling after being scolded [Actor]
rows.description: A toddler told off by a parent turns and pushes a younger sibling or throws a toy; the anger has no safe target so it lands on someone smaller and less threatening.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Kicking the bag after a teacher's rebuke [Actor]
rows.description: A child humiliated in class comes home and slams doors or snaps at the family dog; the feeling belongs to school but is spent where it feels safe.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Snapped at by a stressed teenager [Receiver]
rows.description: A younger sibling is shouted at over nothing after the older one had a bad exam; the receiver feels confused and small, and understanding the cause does not make the harshness acceptable.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A flatmate sees a friend lash out at a delivery person after an unfair evaluation; a quiet remark later about what actually happened often helps more than correcting the outburst in the moment.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: An adult stung by a boss's remark notices their sharpness at home, names the real source, and walks or writes before replying; the anger is then aimed at a fair conversation instead of the family.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A child who copied homework explains that everyone copies and the teacher gives too much anyway; the reasons arrive after the act and protect the self-image of being a good kid.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A teenager who did not prepare decides the exam is unfair and marks do not matter; the story lowers shame now while raising the cost later.

rows.description: A student turned down for a scholarship says they never wanted it and the programme is overrated; the belief eases disappointment but can hide what could be learned from the attempt.

rows.description: A colleague listens to a peer explain at length why a promise slipped, with reasons that keep changing; the tidy logic is a clue that something feels uncomfortable underneath.
